transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get started on the final review for the "Tidal Memory" installation plan. As it stands, the draft proposes online-connected playback, eight visitor stations, 15-minute sessions, and a 5:00 PM public opening on October 12 in Gallery 4. Before I can approve this, I need to hear from each of you — rights, technical, accessibility, and artist representatives — on whether you have any conditions that need to be added to the plan. Let's go around the room.

transcript.text: I need to flag some rights conditions. I reviewed the countersigned music license this morning, and it imposes three requirements: Tidal Memory may be exhibited only through offline local playback — so the current draft's online-connected playback would need to change; visitors may not photograph or record the installation; and the exact credit line 'Music licensed from Harborlight Editions' must be used. I haven't amended the exhibition packet yet because the license arrived after it was circulated.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a technical condition. After yesterday's installation rehearsal, I completed the headset and network test and found that the approved headset model supports only six simultaneous stations, and each session must be limited to exactly 12 minutes to prevent thermal shutdown. The current draft proposes eight stations and 15-minute sessions, both of which would exceed what the hardware can safely handle. The test report is still in the equipment vendor's queue, so it hasn't been circulated yet, but these limits need to be incorporated into the plan before we can proceed.

transcript.text: I need to flag accessibility conditions. I confirmed with the festival's access consultant today that one of the six stations must be a seated, step-free station, and that every visitor notice must display the exact warning 'Flashing light and sudden sound.' The consultant's written confirmation came in after the draft visitor signage was already sent to print, so the printed signage will need to be corrected before opening.

transcript.text: I need to flag an artist-side condition. I confirmed with the artist's manager this afternoon that the artist will permit public access on October 12 only from 6:00 PM onward — not 5:00 PM as currently drafted — and will not permit press or invited photographers inside before that opening. The manager's email is awaiting entry in the artist file, so this hasn't been reflected in the plan yet.
